text:
claire: FYI I opened a tiny RFC + preview job for 'autosweep' — an automated candidate detector for stale runtime config. It will only flag candidates in preview mode and export a per-owner diff. Looking for rapid feedback on owner resolution, rollback tokens, and console UX before we consider deletes. :mag:

hugo: Cool. Two immediate asks: (1) owner resolution MUST be deterministic and auditable, (2) we need an emergency rollback token that can undelete without full restore if tombstone still present.

ops-bot: [job] autosweep.preview started: run=autosweep-2024-07-11T16:00Z id=a-20240711-1 :gear:

telemetry: For visibility we should emit three events: `autosweep.preview.start`, `autosweep.preview.item` (sampled), and `autosweep.preview.report`. Include owner_resolved_from and owner_resolution_trace. We'll also add metrics `autosweep.candidates` and `autosweep.per_owner_pending`.

devex: UX note: Console should display an "At-risk configs" card for owners with a 7-day soft-hold link. Include a small timeline and a safelist button. If owner unresolved, send digest to the shared inbox and show banner to platform-ops.

ryan: About rollback tokens: propose we attach a short-lived id to each scheduled prune: `rollback_token: aSdf1234` that lets ops trigger an undelete endpoint which fast-reverts tombstones within TTL. Tokens expire at tombstone expiry. We should log the token use.

claire: I like `rollback_token`. We'll also maintain snapshots. Plan: soft-hold 7d (UI visible), tombstone 14d after final prune, token valid until tombstone expiry. Token usage requires audit and operator id.

product: Edge-case: experiments often create keys, flip them off, then never remove. Owners may be unknown (migrated services). For owner resolution we should: metadata.owner -> audit.creator -> last-modifier-service -> fallback `platform-ops`. Must include the resolution trace in the diff CSV.

hugo: Agree. Also: exclude keys younger than 45d from any prune candidate. Flag keys 30-45d as "early-warning" only.

telemetry: Sampling rules: 1% for low-traffic candidate pool (<5 reads/month), 100% for items with last_seen > 365d and zero lookups. Payload example we'll emit (sampled):

`{
  "event": "autosweep.preview.item",
  "key": "payments.dynamic_slope.v3",
  "owner": "payments-service",
  "owner_resolved_from": "audit.creator",
  "owner_resolution_trace": "owner(metadata) -> audit.creator -> last-modifier -> fallback:platform-ops",
  "created_at": "2022-11-02T08:00:00Z",
  "last_seen": "2023-01-10T12:20:00Z",
  "lookups_90d": 0,
  "labels": ["ab_test"]
}`

devex: For the Console banner CTA: text = "Request hold (7d)" -> opens modal with prefilled owner email and reclaim link. Also add weekly owner digest CSV export during preview. I'll draft copy in the PR.

ops-bot: [note] Initial rate limit: preview capped to 6k keys/hour; run uses shard cursors + watermark to avoid full scans.

ryan: Ops checklist: snapshot before any hard prune, tombstone retention 14d, `rollback_token` issuance logged, and pre-delete smoke-restore test in staging. Also require two approvers for first 48h of production deletes (ops + owner or product).

claire: Summary I'll add to PR: 1) preview-only mode emits sampled telemetry + owner diff CSVs, 2) owner resolution trace included, 3) UI banners + 7-day soft-hold + safelist API, 4) `rollback_token` per prune with TTL until tombstone expiry, 5) exclude <45d; flag 30-45d as early-warning, 6) snapshot + tombstone 14d + staged rollout, 7) rate-limited cursored scans. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/autosweep/pull/4

hugo: LGTM from platform side pending PR details on watermarking and cursor checkpoints.

telemetry: ack, will add schemas and sampling rules.

devex: ack, will add banner/modal copy and digest template.

ops-bot: [audit] autosweep.preview a-20240711-1 triggered by claire.

claire: Holding any destructive step until ops + telemetry + devex thumbs and a successful canary preview. Will update PR with token format and audit hooks. Thanks all. :v:
